Cash-only consideration: $180.00 per share, without interest; no stock, CVRs, or other forms are included.
Per Share Merger Consideration: $180.00 in cash, without interest; Exchange Ratio: (i) the Per Share Merger Consideration, divided by (ii) the volumed weighted average trading price per share of Parent Common Stock for the 10-trading day period ending on and including the Closing Date, as reported by the New York Stock Exchange; Other forms of consideration include: cash-out of Company Options (excess of Per Share Merger Consideration over exercise price times the number of underlying Shares); conversion of Company RSU Awards into Parent RSU Awards (number of Shares underlying prior to Effective Time multiplied by the Exchange Ratio); cash-out of Company PSU Awards (Per Share Merger Consideration times number of underlying Shares, based on target performance); Company Equity Payments (aggregate amounts owed to holders of Company Equity Awards, to be paid by the Surviving Corporation).
Exchange Ratio equals Per Share Merger Consideration ($180 in cash) divided by the 10-trading day volume weighted average price per share of Parent Common Stock ending on and including the Closing Date (as reported by the New York Stock Exchange).
